newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Polymer Systems in pact with J&J.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Polymer Systems in pact with J&J.

text.p: Advanced Polymer Systems Inc and Johnson & Johnson Consumer Products Inc said they signed a license and supply agreement under which Advanced Polymer will provide Johnson & Johnson Consumer Products with a formulation incorporating patented Microsponge delivery systems and alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs).
Johnson and Johnson Consumer Products will incorporate the Microsponge-entrapped AHAs into some new products within its Purpose brand of dermatologist-recommended skin care products.

Under terms of the agreement, Advanced Polymer will receive manufacturing revenues and royalties on product sales, with guaranteed minimums. In return, Johnson & Johnson has nonexclusive rights to use Microsponge-entrapped AHAs in skin care products throughout the world.
